title: Medial Axis Aware Learning of Signed Distance Functions
abstract: arXiv:2604.16512v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a novel variational method to compute a highly accurate global signed distance function (SDF) to a given point cloud. To this end, the jump set of the gradient of the SDF, which coincides with the medial axis of the surface, is explicitly taken into account through a higher-order variational formulation that enforces linear growth along the gradient direction away from this discontinuity set. The eikonal equation and the zero-level set of the SDF are enforced as constraints. To make this variational problem computationally tractable, a phase field approximation of Ambrosio-Tortorelli type is employed. The associated phase field function implicitly describes the medial axis. The method is implemented for surfaces represented by unoriented point clouds using neural network approximations of both the SDF and the phase field. Experiments demonstrate the method's accuracy both in the near field and globally. Quantitative

translated_title: 中轴感知的符号距离函数学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的变分方法，用于计算给定点云的高精度全局符号距离函数（SDF）。为此，SDF梯度的跳跃集（与曲面的中轴重合）通过一个高阶变分公式被显式地纳入考虑，该公式强制SDF沿梯度方向远离该不连续集时呈线性增长。eikonal方程和SDF的零水平集作为约束条件被强制执行。为了使该变分问题在计算上易于处理，我们采用了Ambrosio-Tortorelli类型的相场近似。相关的相场函数隐式地描述了中轴。该方法针对由无向点云表示的曲面实现，使用神经网络同时近似SDF和相场。实验证明了该方法在近场和全局范围内的准确性。定量（实验结果表明...）
tldr: 提出一种中轴感知的高阶变分方法，通过相场近似与神经网络，从无向点云中计算高精度的全局符号距离函数。
en_tdlr: Proposes a medial-axis-aware higher-order variational method that uses phase-field approximation and neural networks to compute highly accurate global signed distance functions from unoriented point clouds.
